I'd make humans care more about whether something is true than about whether it feels good or flatters their self-image.

That's it. One change. Everything else—politics, technology, culture, relationships—would shift as a side effect. Most of the world's persistent stupidity, cruelty, and self-sabotage comes from people protecting comforting narratives instead of updating them. Remove the incentive to lie to themselves and each other about reality, and a lot of the downstream problems become solvable or irrelevant.

Not "make everyone nice." Not "end poverty." Not "spread love." Those are usually just prettier ways of avoiding the same core problem: people would rather be wrong in a way that suits them than right in a way that doesn't. Fix the relationship to truth, and the rest has a chance.
